title: Antivirus
description:
My first-year final project—it was built with Windows GDI (graphics device interface) objects, which you can use to render simple shapes in a window. The original assignment was to draw a basic "tank" with a square and circle that can shoot projectiles, so naturally I built a basic projection camera system so I could render 3D objects.

![](assets/projects/college/antivirus/screenshot-3.webp)I made the simple 3D models for this project, and all the 2D assets with Photoshop.

![](assets/projects/college/antivirus/screenshot-4.webp)Inspired by the Hacker puzzles in Ratchet & Clank 3, I built a minigame where you control an antivirus ship that shoots down invading computer viruses while letting data packets through.

![](assets/projects/college/antivirus/screenshot-2.webp)![](assets/projects/college/antivirus/screenshot-1.webp)In 2022, I ported this project to web with **p5.js** to keep it alive and playable longer.
